title: Feature Wishes and Size Constraints
summary: This topic is mostly a loose cluster of customer feature wishes and vehicle size observations, with only one clearly positive comparison point and many comments whose sentiment is not explicit.

positive.summary: One positive review praises the current navigation by wishing its graphics were even more refined rather than criticizing the vehicle outright.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined comments mention desired features such as Dog Mode, tailgate key-fob closing, radio replay, moonroof opening, and wider trunk access, alongside observations about the vehicle being longer or wider and one note about accommodating a dog.

limitations: The topic mixes unrelated subjects, including feature requests, size and garage-fit observations, trunk and tailgate usability, audio functionality, and a note about dog-related interior cleanliness.
Most examples are assigned undetermined sentiment, so the emotional direction of many wishes or observations cannot be stated confidently.
The sample provides only one clearly positive example and no explicit negative, mixed, or neutral examples, limiting sentiment-specific conclusions.
